evidence.AC1: POST /todos with {"title":"past","dueDate":"2026-10-14"} returned 201 with "dueDate":"2026-10-14". A POST without dueDate returned 201 with dueDate null. The date is a plain calendar date with no time.
evidence.AC2: PATCH /todos/4 {"dueDate":"2026-03-01"} returned 200 with dueDate 2026-03-01. PATCH {"dueDate":null} returned 200 with dueDate null, so the date was removed. PATCH {"title":"future2"} left the existing dueDate 2026-12-01 unchanged.
evidence.AC3: POST with dueDate 2026-02-30, 15.10.2026 and 2026-10-15T10:00:00 each returned HTTP 400. PATCH with 2026-13-01 and 2026-02-30 each returned HTTP 400.
evidence.AC4: Today is 2026-10-15 (UTC). I created todos due yesterday, today, in the future, with no date, and one due 2026-01-01 that I marked done. GET /todos?overdue=true returned only the todo due 2026-10-14. The due-today, future, no-date and done-past todos were all excluded.
evidence.AC5: The page at / shows each todo's due date as text (2026-10-14, 2026-10-15, 2026-12-01 and 2026-01-01). The todo with no date shows none.
evidence.AC6: In the page snapshot only the todo "past" (due 2026-10-14, not done) shows "überfällig". The due-today, future, no-date and done-past todos show no such word.
evidence.AC7: The page has a checkbox labelled "nur überfällige". Before clicking, all 5 todos were listed. After clicking it, the list showed only "past".
